longTitle.officialTitle: To reauthorize the Congressional Award Act.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Congressional Award Program Reauthorization Act of 2018”.

subsection.heading: In General.—
subsection.content: Section 108 of the Congressional Award Act (2 U.S.C. 808) is amended by striking “October 1, 2018” and inserting “October 1, 2023”.

subsection.heading: Effective Date.—
subsection.content: The amendment made by subsection (a) shall take effect on October 1, 2018.
